title: Starmap
description: The root of star-systems.json: every star system on the starmap.

modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last written.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last wrote the file.

starSystems.description: Every star system, keyed by the id of its active definition.

StarSystem.description: A star system with its active definition and its career state. The story swaps some star systems' definitions (e.g. to change their owner); the id and what the definition holds are the active one's.

id.description: The active definition's id, as in the references to the star system.

name.description: The name, as in the references to the star system.

owner.description: The faction that owns the star system.

tags.description: The star system's tags, sorted, which the events' requirements check, also those its starmap panel doesn't show.

biomes.description: The biomes the star system's missions can be on, sorted by name.

maps.description: The maps the star system's contracts can be fought on, as the contract generator selects them from its biomes and map tags; each map's terrain is in the catalog's mapDefinitions.

stores.description: The item collections each of the star system's stores draws its stock from on arrival, every entry of each once, by their ids in the catalog's itemCollectionDefinitions, sorted. A store without any doesn't exist in the star system.

contractEmployers.description: The factions that can hire the company for the star system's generated contracts, sorted by name, each with the factions it can hire it against; a contract's own requirements can narrow them further. Story and flashpoint contracts name their own.

difficulty.description: The star system's difficulty, as the starmap shows it.

canTravelTo.description: Whether the star system's travel requirements are met; story systems stay locked until then.

route.description: The trip from the current star system; null where the game finds no route, always while canTravelTo is false.

DefinitionReference.description: A game definition: its id from the game's data files and the name shown in the UI.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

ByStoreOfIReadOnlyListOfString.description: A value per store of a star system: its system store, faction store and black market.

system.description: The value for the system store.

faction.description: The value for the faction store.

blackMarket.description: The value for the black market.

employer.description: A faction that can hire the company in the star system.

targets.description: The factions it can hire the company against there, sorted by name: its enemies among the star system's targets, except the company's allies.

Route.description: The trip from the current star system, as the starmap plans and shows it.

days.description: The days the trip takes from the current star system's planet, as the starmap shows them while the ship is there, with the whole leg to its jump point (jumpPointDays), also the part already travelled during a trip (see legEndsOnDay). 0 for the current star system.

cost.description: The C-Bills the trip costs; 0 for the current star system.
